nodes.name: On Telegram Message
nodes.notes: REQUIRES SETUP: attach the same Telegram API credential used in the 'Signal - Daily Brief' workflow. This is a separate trigger-based workflow because it's event-driven (fires on incoming messages), not scheduled -- keep it active independently of the daily brief workflow.

nodes.name: Extract Arc Status
nodes.notes: Same SIGNAL_API_BASE_URL env var as the daily brief workflow. Covered by tests/test_api.py::TestArcStatusExtract (6 tests: real extraction, unrelated text, empty/null/whitespace text, default vs. stored known-projects, update-not-duplicate on a second mention).

nodes.name: Send Confirmation
nodes.notes: chatId is pulled from the ORIGINAL trigger message (via the $('Node Name') expression), not from the HTTP response, since the response body doesn't carry it. Standard n8n cross-node expression syntax -- verify it resolves correctly in your editor, same caveat as the other hand-authored nodes (see README).

meta.notes: Hand-authored, structurally validated by scripts/validate_n8n_workflow.py -- same NOT-live-imported caveat as signal_workflow.json (see README, this sandbox couldn't install n8n). Deliberately linear (no IF/Switch node) rather than branching on message type inside n8n, specifically so there's no additional untestable node schema to guess at beyond telegramTrigger/telegram, which the daily-brief workflow already required verifying.
